title: Stellaris Odyssey
summary: A sweeping space opera following the crew of the starship Horizon as they confront cosmic anomalies and political intrigue.

events.title: Launch of the Horizon
events.description: The experimental starship Horizon embarks on its maiden voyage to chart uncharted wormholes.

events.title: First Contact at Helios Gate
events.description: Captain Lira Sol brokers peace with the crystalline Helian Collective after a tense standoff.

events.title: Collapse of the Maelstrom Rift
events.description: The Horizon sacrifices its quantum sails to stabilize a collapsing rift threatening inhabited systems.

events.title: Return to Terra Prime
events.description: After three years missing, the Horizon reappears over Terra Prime carrying a sentient nebula seeking asylum.

title: Chronicles of Avaloria
summary: An epic fantasy saga chronicling the rise of the Mage-Queen Elowen and the unification of the fractured realm of Avaloria.

events.title: The Emberfall Prophecy
events.description: Young Elowen discovers the prophecy foretelling a mage who will rekindle the Emberlight and unite the clans.

events.title: Siege of Frostspire Keep
events.description: Elowen leads a daring assault to reclaim Frostspire from the Wraithbound and secure the northern trade routes.

events.title: Crowning at the Luminous Well
events.description: The clans pledge fealty as Elowen channels the Emberlight to forge a unified Avalorian covenant.

events.title: Treaty of Verdant Hollow
events.description: Avaloria signs a historic peace with the Sylvan Courts, ending centuries of forest skirmishes.
